items.en: Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
items.zh: 新增信任对话框警告，说明文件夹的 hooks 在何处声明

items.en: Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load
items.zh: 在 Claude Desktop 及其他非交互式宿主中，当托管设置里的 hooks 加载失败时，在对话中新增警告

items.en: Added this session's scheduled tasks, `/loop` wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to `/tasks`; x stops one after asking
items.zh: 将本次 session 的定时任务、`/loop` 唤醒、目标以及本次对话的分叉加入 `/tasks`；x 会在询问后停止其中一个

items.en: Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in `/mcp` that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection
items.zh: 在 `/mcp` 中服务器的页面上新增“Server message”一行，显示拒绝连接的远程 HTTP MCP 服务器的 JSON-RPC 错误消息

items.en: Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to `/status` that names managed marketplaces that get no automatic updates, and why
items.zh: 在 `/status` 中新增“Marketplace auto-update”一行，列出不会自动更新的托管 marketplace 及其原因

items.en: Added support for turning on Code Mode while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled; each tool call the code makes sends its events; tracing still keeps it off
items.zh: 新增支持：在启用 OpenTelemetry 事件和指标的同时开启 Code Mode；代码发起的每次工具调用都会发送其事件；启用追踪时仍会保持关闭

items.en: \[VSCode] Added a line above the message box after you decline the trust prompt, with Review trust to bring the prompt back without reloading the window
items.zh: \[VSCode] 在你拒绝信任提示后，在消息框上方新增一行，包含 Review trust，可在不重新加载窗口的情况下重新显示该提示

items.en: Updated computer use on macOS to newer safety rules, so some actions are refused and some apps have less access
items.zh: 将 macOS 上的 computer use 更新为更新的安全规则，因此部分操作会被拒绝，部分应用的访问权限减少

items.en: Changed saved scheduled tasks: in new signed-in sessions, most saved by earlier versions need scheduling again, though `--resume` of their own session still runs them
items.zh: 变更已保存的定时任务：在新的已登录 session 中，大多数由早期版本保存的任务需要重新调度，但用 `--resume` 恢复其所属 session 时仍会运行它们

items.en: Changed `/code-review` with no target on most models to review the whole branch against the default branch, and fixed it losing the diff on multi-commit branches
items.zh: 变更 `/code-review`：在大多数模型上不带目标时，改为对照默认分支审查整个分支，并修复其在多提交分支上丢失 diff 的问题

items.en: Changed auto mode to run `git status` less often so most requests wait less in large repositories; a git command that discards changes may be blocked until the working tree is checked
items.zh: 变更自动模式，降低 `git status` 的执行频率，使大型仓库中大多数请求等待更少；在检查工作树之前，可能阻止会丢弃更改的 git 命令

items.en: Changed `/code-review <pr number> --fix`, and `/code-review` given a pull request URL, to stop without reviewing when `gh pr diff` is refused or fails
items.zh: 变更 `/code-review <pr number> --fix` 以及传入拉取请求 URL 的 `/code-review`：当 `gh pr diff` 被拒绝或失败时，停止而不进行审查

items.en: Changed 'Exit and stop tasks' to end this session's scheduled tasks so they don't run again on resume, unless you exit while Claude is responding
items.zh: 变更“Exit and stop tasks”，使其结束本次 session 的定时任务，以免在恢复时再次运行，除非你在 Claude 正在响应时退出

items.en: Changed some teammate panes to start through /bin/sh, so they may not read shell start-up files
items.zh: 变更部分队友窗格，改为通过 /bin/sh 启动，因此它们可能不会读取 shell 启动文件

items.en: Changed computer use on macOS to give up on an app launch that has not finished after 30 seconds
items.zh: 变更 macOS 上的 computer use，对 30 秒后仍未完成的应用启动放弃等待

items.en: Gateway: Changed the start-up warning shown while `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty to a notice at every start, boxed in text logs: never expose the gateway to the public internet
items.zh: 网关：将 `access_control.allow_cidrs` 为空时显示的启动警告改为每次启动时的提示，并在文本日志中加框显示：切勿将网关暴露到公网

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed a second host name's clone of the same owner/name to go under `_repos/clones/<host>/` in the base folder; no clone moves
items.zh: 自托管运行器：变更第二个主机名对同一 owner/name 的克隆，改为放在基础文件夹下的 `_repos/clones/<host>/`；不会移动任何克隆

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed repositories with unusual characters in their address path to clone anew in a new folder; rules and volumes naming the old one stop applying, and the old clone stays put
items.zh: 自托管运行器：变更地址路径中含特殊字符的仓库，改为在新文件夹中重新克隆；引用旧文件夹的规则和卷将不再生效，旧克隆保持原位

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Changed `--repository-folder` to take most folders in the base folder at `--capacity 1` (above 1, one there stops start-up); another repository's session overlapping one is refused
items.zh: 自托管运行器：变更 `--repository-folder`，在 `--capacity 1` 时接受基础文件夹中的大多数文件夹（大于 1 时，其中存在一个会阻止启动）；另一仓库的 session 与其重叠时会被拒绝

items.en: Changed Code Mode so a PreToolUse hook that errors no longer refuses a script's tool call, as outside Code Mode; set `"onFailure": "block"` on a command, HTTP or MCP tool hook that must refuse
items.zh: 变更 Code Mode：出错的 PreToolUse hook 不再像 Code Mode 之外那样拒绝脚本的工具调用；对于必须拒绝的命令、HTTP 或 MCP 工具 hook，请设置 `"onFailure": "block"`

items.en: Changed Code Mode to refuse a script's read of a line range over 256 MiB, which could use gigabytes of memory, and fixed reads of very long lines timing out
items.zh: 变更 Code Mode，拒绝脚本读取超过 256 MiB 的行范围（这可能占用数 GB 内存），并修复读取超长行时超时的问题

items.en: Changed Code Mode to also start when telemetry, nonessential traffic or feature flags are turned off; an administrator can keep it off in managed settings
items.zh: 变更 Code Mode，在遥测、非必要流量或功能开关关闭时也会启动；管理员可在托管设置中将其保持关闭

items.en: Changed Code Mode to run a script that declares its own `log`, `preview` or `sleep`, which it used to refuse
items.zh: 变更 Code Mode，允许运行自行声明 `log`、`preview` 或 `sleep` 的脚本（此前会拒绝）

items.en: Changed macOS login renewal to test the Keychain with a `Claude Code-write-check` item
items.zh: 变更 macOS 登录续期，改用 `Claude Code-write-check` 项测试钥匙串

items.en: Changed the `/tasks` header and the footer's background count to one number covering shells, monitors, MCP calls, agents, workflows and scheduled tasks
items.zh: 变更 `/tasks` 标题和页脚的后台数量，统一为一个数字，涵盖 shell、监控、MCP 调用、agent、工作流和定时任务

items.en: Changed Stop and SubagentStop hooks to list a Monitor's script as `monitor`, not `shell`, in `background_tasks`
items.zh: 变更 Stop 和 SubagentStop hook，在 `background_tasks` 中将 Monitor 的脚本列为 `monitor` 而非 `shell`

items.en: Removed 2.1.326's automatic retry at the limit named in a `max_tokens` error; behind a gateway whose model takes fewer output tokens, set `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` to that limit
items.zh: 移除 2.1.326 中按 `max_tokens` 错误所指定上限自动重试的行为；若位于模型输出 token 更少的网关之后，请将 `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` 设为该上限

items.en: \[VSCode] Changed Down to stop at the last item of a permission prompt instead of wrapping to Yes
items.zh: \[VSCode] 变更 Down 键行为，在权限提示的最后一项停止，而不再回绕到 Yes

items.en: \[VSCode] Changed command output to show hidden characters and control sequences other than plain colors as symbols, so Persian, Khmer, Lao, Sinhala and Malayalam text can look broken or out of order
items.zh: \[VSCode] 变更命令输出，将纯颜色以外的隐藏字符和控制序列显示为符号，因此波斯文、高棉文、老挝文、僧伽罗文和马拉雅拉姆文可能显示错乱或顺序颠倒

items.en: Improved the automatic clean-up of old sessions on computers with managed settings
items.zh: 改进在启用托管设置的计算机上对旧 session 的自动清理

items.en: Improved `/tui` and other in-place restarts to wait briefly for a login refresh, so they are less likely to sign you out
items.zh: 改进 `/tui` 及其他原地重启，短暂等待登录刷新，降低将你登出的可能性

items.en: Improved memory use in long sessions that edit many files, and in long Claude Desktop sessions on macOS and Linux with many large MCP tool results
items.zh: 改进长时间编辑大量文件的 session 的内存占用，以及 macOS 和 Linux 上包含大量大型 MCP 工具结果的长时间 Claude Desktop session 的内存占用

items.en: Windows: Improved start-up and the first search on PCs where Claude Code's search program starts slowly
items.zh: Windows：改进 Claude Code 搜索程序启动缓慢的 PC 上的启动和首次搜索

items.en: Improved auto mode's handling of a short reply such as "yes" to Claude's question when telemetry is off, behind a gateway to the Anthropic API, or on Microsoft Foundry
items.zh: 改进自动模式在遥测关闭、位于 Anthropic API 网关之后或使用 Microsoft Foundry 时，对 Claude 提问的简短回复（如“yes”）的处理

items.en: Improved memory use of idle Claude Desktop and SDK sessions after a long turn, and after `--resume` or `--continue` of a session that holds screenshots or large tool results
items.zh: 改进空闲 Claude Desktop 和 SDK session 在长时间回合后的内存占用，以及对包含截图或大型工具结果的 session 执行 `--resume` 或 `--continue` 后的内存占用

items.en: Improved how fast a Claude Desktop Code session with Remote Control on is ready for the next message after an answer
items.zh: 改进开启远程控制的 Claude Desktop Code session 在回答后准备接收下一条消息的速度

items.en: Improved cloud sessions to retry plugins that failed to download at startup
items.zh: 改进云 session，对启动时下载失败的 plugin 进行重试

items.en: Improved Code Mode: the terminal freezes for far less time after a script makes thousands of tool calls
items.zh: 改进 Code Mode：脚本发起数千次工具调用后，终端卡顿时间大幅缩短

items.en: Improved Code Mode: after starting a subagent, Claude now gets the same guidance on waiting as outside Code Mode
items.zh: 改进 Code Mode：启动 subagent 后，Claude 现在会收到与 Code Mode 之外相同的等待指引

items.en: Fixed `~/.claude.json` sometimes being reset to defaults when a network stall or file lock made it unreadable and cleared during a save
items.zh: 修复 `~/.claude.json` 有时在网络停滞或文件锁导致其无法读取、并在保存过程中被清空时被重置为默认值的问题

items.en: Fixed repeated sign-outs on macOS when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not save to it. That session now stops at expiry and says why, and other sessions stay signed in
items.zh: 修复了 macOS 上 Claude Code 能读取钥匙串但无法写入时反复退出登录的问题。该 session 现在会在到期时停止并说明原因，其他 session 保持登录状态

items.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string
items.zh: 修复了 `/terminal-setup` 在块注释附近损坏 VS Code 设置或 keybindings 文件的问题，以及当 keybindings.json 中存在未闭合字符串时报告成功却丢失 Shift+Enter 绑定的问题

items.en: Fixed files accepted through the IDE diff being saved without their last newline, and losing their byte order mark (BOM) when an edit was accepted by saving the diff in VS Code
items.zh: 修复了通过 IDE diff 接受的文件在保存时丢失末尾换行符的问题，以及当在 VS Code 中通过保存 diff 接受编辑时丢失字节顺序标记（BOM）的问题

items.en: Fixed picking a cloud session in `/teleport` replacing your open conversation: the pick now starts a new session, as `/clear` does, and `/resume` brings the old one back
items.zh: 修复了在 `/teleport` 中选择云 session 会替换当前打开的对话的问题：现在选择会像 `/clear` 一样启动新 session，而 `/resume` 可以恢复原来的对话

items.en: Fixed `/usage-credits` asking Pro and Max users to log in again after opening the browser, and the link disappearing after 8 seconds if the browser doesn't open and a task stops for usage credits
items.zh: 修复了 `/usage-credits` 在 Pro 和 Max 用户打开浏览器后要求重新登录的问题，以及浏览器未打开时链接在 8 秒后消失、任务因用量额度而停止的问题

items.en: Fixed `/usage` saying usage credits are off when they had run out or reached the monthly limit, and `/model` not telling Pro and Max users when that limit blocks a model that runs on usage credits
items.zh: 修复了 `/usage` 在用量额度已用完或达到月度上限时仍显示用量额度已关闭的问题，以及 `/model` 在该上限阻止依赖用量额度的模型时未告知 Pro 和 Max 用户的问题

items.en: Fixed the spend limit menu showing your spend as your monthly limit and wrapping its rows under the pointer in narrow windows
items.zh: 修复了支出上限菜单将你的支出显示为月度上限的问题，以及窄窗口中菜单行在指针下方换行的问题

items.en: Fixed a status line script that prints without end freezing the prompt and using gigabytes of memory
items.zh: 修复了状态栏脚本无限输出导致 prompt 卡死并占用数 GB 内存的问题

items.en: Fixed an empty, frozen screen after approving managed settings while the --resume picker, the trust dialog or another set-up screen was waiting
items.zh: 修复了在 `--resume` 选择器、信任对话框或其他设置界面等待时批准托管设置后出现空白冻结屏幕的问题

items.en: Fixed choosing Default in `/model` replacing your saved model with your organization's default when the Default row already showed your saved model
items.zh: 修复了当 Default 行已显示你保存的模型时，在 `/model` 中选择 Default 会用组织默认值替换你保存的模型的问题

items.en: Fixed an MCP server being signed in again after you cleared its authentication while a token refresh was running
items.zh: 修复了在 token 刷新进行期间清除 MCP server 的认证后该 server 又被重新登录的问题

items.en: Fixed background MCP tasks that stalled after a slow reconnect: Claude Code now reconnects most HTTP MCP servers by itself when one is left on an older protocol version
items.zh: 修复了后台 MCP 任务在缓慢重连后停滞的问题：当某个 HTTP MCP server 停留在较旧的协议版本时，Claude Code 现在会自动重连大多数 HTTP MCP server

items.en: Fixed PDFs, images and `.docx`, `.xlsx` or `.pptx` files that MCP servers or websites send as `application/octet-stream` being saved as .bin, which kept Claude from reading the PDFs and images
items.zh: 修复了 MCP server 或网站以 `application/octet-stream` 发送的 PDF、图片及 `.docx`、`.xlsx` 或 `.pptx` 文件被保存为 .bin 的问题，该问题导致 Claude 无法读取这些 PDF 和图片

items.en: Fixed `/code-review <pr number>` sometimes reviewing the checked-out branch instead of the pull request without saying so: it now reads the pull request with `gh pr diff`, or says when it can't
items.zh: 修复了 `/code-review <pr number>` 有时在未说明的情况下审查已检出的分支而非 pull request 的问题：现在会通过 `gh pr diff` 读取 pull request，无法读取时会明确说明

items.en: Fixed `/code-review` stopping at a permission prompt, on most models, to look for a `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` that doesn't exist
items.zh: 修复了 `/code-review` 在大多数模型上因查找不存在的 `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` 而在权限提示处停止的问题

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed `--push-outcome-on-release` sometimes deleting a session's branch on the git host
items.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了 `--push-outcome-on-release` 有时会删除 git 主机上某个 session 分支的问题

items.en: Fixed Code Mode hiding a script's finished edits and the stopped command after Esc, and losing them on exit
items.zh: 修复了 Code Mode 在按 Esc 后隐藏脚本已完成的编辑和已停止的命令，以及退出时丢失这些内容的问题

items.en: Fixed a runaway loop in Code Mode filling the machine's memory; it is now stopped at a limit
items.zh: 修复了 Code Mode 中失控循环占满机器内存的问题；现在会在达到上限时停止

items.en: Fixed a background agent running on when it was stopped while it was being resumed
items.zh: 修复了后台 agent 在恢复过程中被停止后仍继续运行的问题

items.en: Fixed background shell commands using memory for the earlier conversation until they exit
items.zh: 修复了后台 shell 命令在退出前一直占用内存保存先前对话的问题

items.en: Fixed Remote Control using memory for the earlier conversation after a compaction or `/clear` in sessions run by Claude Desktop, IDEs or the SDK
items.zh: 修复了在 Claude Desktop、IDE 或 SDK 运行的 session 中，经过上下文压缩或 `/clear` 后，远程控制仍使用内存中较早对话内容的问题

items.en: Fixed Stop not ending a request in Claude Desktop sessions on Bedrock while it waits on a hung AWS credential\_process or sign-in call
items.zh: 修复了在 Bedrock 上的 Claude Desktop session 中，当请求等待卡住的 AWS credential\_process 或登录调用时，Stop 无法结束请求的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude sometimes failing to send you a file on its first try on Opus 4.8 and Opus 5
items.zh: 修复了在 Opus 4.8 和 Opus 5 上，Claude 有时首次尝试无法向你发送文件的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude not being told that a connected MCP server's tools could not be loaded, and taking it for a server with no tools, in sessions with tool search
items.zh: 修复了在启用工具搜索的 session 中，Claude 未被告知已连接的 MCP 服务器的工具无法加载，而将其误认为没有工具的服务器的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude mcp login` and `/mcp` saying a service doesn't accept sign-ins from Claude Code when the service's client registration had been retired (HTTP 410 Gone)
items.zh: 修复了当服务的客户端注册已被注销（HTTP 410 Gone）时，`claude mcp login` 和 `/mcp` 提示该服务不接受来自 Claude Code 的登录的问题

items.en: Fixed another case of claude.ai-synced plugin hooks failing with "Plugin directory does not exist" while a session was still running on macOS
items.zh: 修复了 macOS 上 session 仍在运行时，claude.ai 同步的 plugin hook 因“Plugin directory does not exist”而失败的另一种情况

items.en: Fixed auto mode asking for manual approval to `rm` a symlink that points outside the working directory or at itself
items.zh: 修复了自动模式对指向工作目录之外或指向自身的符号链接执行 `rm` 时要求手动批准的问题

items.en: Fixed `/sandbox` on Linux listing `allowUnixSockets` entries as allowed: they don't open those sockets there, and `/sandbox` now says so
items.zh: 修复了 Linux 上 `/sandbox` 将 `allowUnixSockets` 条目列为已允许的问题：在该平台上它们不会打开这些套接字，`/sandbox` 现在会说明这一点

items.en: Fixed pressing Esc twice to clear a mistyped code ending the sign-in in `/install-github-app`
items.zh: 修复了在 `/install-github-app` 中按两次 Esc 清除输错的代码时导致登录结束的问题

items.en: Remote Control: Fixed sessions going back to their first effort level after a restart while the app still showed the level you picked (not yet for sessions that start in Ultracode)
items.zh: 远程控制：修复了重启后 session 回到最初的 effort 级别，而应用仍显示你所选级别的问题（以 Ultracode 启动的 session 尚未修复）

items.en: Fixed a removed plugin's MCP server staying connected in headless sessions after `reload_plugins` or when the account's plugin list drops it
items.zh: 修复了在无头 session 中，执行 `reload_plugins` 后或账户的 plugin 列表移除某个 plugin 后，已移除 plugin 的 MCP 服务器仍保持连接的问题

items.en: Fixed the Claude Docs connector's tools going missing when a plugin or MCP server at the same address failed to connect, and its error wrongly suggesting `/login`
items.zh: 修复了当同一地址的 plugin 或 MCP 服务器连接失败时，Claude Docs connector 的工具消失，且其错误信息错误地建议使用 `/login` 的问题

items.en: Fixed a new skills, commands or agents folder being missed when `--add-dir` names the working directory or Claude Code starts in the home folder
items.zh: 修复了当 `--add-dir` 指定工作目录或 Claude Code 在主目录中启动时，新的 skills、commands 或 agents 文件夹被遗漏的问题

items.en: Fixed sessions started from a pre-warmed process ignoring the `autoCompactWindow` setting in the project's `.claude/settings.json`
items.zh: 修复了从预热进程启动的 session 忽略项目 `.claude/settings.json` 中 `autoCompactWindow` 设置的问题

items.en: Fixed `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` staying in effect in a running session after it is removed from settings.json
items.zh: 修复了从 settings.json 中移除 `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` 后，该变量在运行中的 session 里仍然生效的问题

items.en: Fixed the Agent tool's `effort` parameter being ignored for named teammates in agent teams
items.zh: 修复了 agent teams 中 Agent 工具的 `effort` 参数对具名队友被忽略的问题

items.en: Fixed `/auto-mode-setup` ignoring recent auto mode denials when it scans a project for rules to suggest; it may now offer allow rules from them, and you review each before it's saved
items.zh: 修复了 `/auto-mode-setup` 在扫描项目以建议规则时忽略近期自动模式拒绝记录的问题；现在它可能会据此提供允许规则，每条规则保存前都会由你审核

items.en: Fixed a false "Couldn't save this change" warning after adding a permission rule or directory in a subfolder or worktree whose own `.claude/settings.local.json` is unreadable or malformed
items.zh: 修复了在子文件夹或 worktree 中添加权限规则或目录后，若其自身的 `.claude/settings.local.json` 不可读或格式错误，会出现错误的“Couldn't save this change”警告的问题

items.en: Fixed cloud sessions telling Claude to run a network proxy check after a failed request, which auto mode then blocked
items.zh: 修复了云 session 在请求失败后指示 Claude 运行网络代理检查，而该检查随后被自动模式阻止的问题

items.en: Fixed headless rewind and fork going ahead while a message sent right after a model change still waited on it
items.zh: 修复了在模型切换后立即发送的消息仍在等待时，无头回退和分叉仍继续执行的问题

items.en: Fixed Claude not being told when a background task was stopped while a cloud session was restarting
items.zh: 修复了云 session 重启期间后台任务被停止时，Claude 未收到通知的问题

items.en: Fixed `/team-onboarding` reporting a guide as shared on Team and Enterprise plans when the server refused the upload
items.zh: 修复了在 Team 和 Enterprise 计划下，服务器拒绝上传时 `/team-onboarding` 仍将指南报告为已共享的问题

items.en: Fixed panels and questions being cut off at the prompt in fullscreen, `/help`, history search and the background tasks list losing rows or titles in short windows, and tables wrapping in dialogs
items.zh: 修复了全屏模式下提示符处的面板和问题被截断、`/help`、历史搜索和后台任务列表在较矮窗口中丢失行或标题，以及对话框中的表格换行的问题

items.en: Fixed resumed sessions showing "Rejected" or "Declined" for edits, questions and plans that were cut off when the session ended
items.zh: 修复了恢复的 session 对在 session 结束时被截断的编辑、问题和计划显示“Rejected”或“Declined”的问题

items.en: Fixed `/passes` showing the wrong number of passes after a server error, and offering usage credits for sharing when no guest passes are left
items.zh: 修复了 `/passes` 在服务器出错后显示错误的通行证数量，以及在没有剩余访客通行证时仍提供共享用量额度的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude --help` output being cut short when piped to another program
items.zh: 修复了 `claude --help` 输出通过管道传给其他程序时被截断的问题

items.en: Fixed `/terminal-setup` turning on "Use Option as Meta key" in Terminal.app on macOS 27, and tips there suggesting Option+Enter instead of Shift+Enter
items.zh: 修复了 `/terminal-setup` 在 macOS 27 的 Terminal.app 中开启“Use Option as Meta key”，以及其中的提示建议 Option+Enter 而非 Shift+Enter 的问题

items.en: Self-hosted runner: Fixed setup failing on Git LFS repositories cloned through Anthropic-managed git; sessions now start on pointer files, and `git lfs pull` fetches the content
items.zh: 自托管运行器：修复了通过 Anthropic 托管的 git 克隆的 Git LFS 仓库上设置失败的问题；session 现在从指针文件启动，由 `git lfs pull` 获取内容

items.en: Fixed sessions on self-hosted environments not starting from a git remote with an SSH host alias, GitHub SSH certificates or a GHE.com SSH user; an unresolved alias's error gives two git commands
items.zh: 修复了自托管环境中的 session 无法从带有 SSH 主机别名、GitHub SSH 证书或 GHE.com SSH 用户的 git 远程启动的问题；未解析别名的错误会给出两条 git 命令

items.en: Fixed remote MCP servers in self-hosted runner sessions staying without tools, or (over https) disconnected, after a timeout or network error
items.zh: 修复了自托管运行器 session 中的远程 MCP 服务器在超时或网络错误后一直无工具可用，或（通过 https）断开连接的问题

items.en: Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as having stopped responding while Claude Code was still starting
items.zh: 修复了自托管运行器 session 在 Claude Code 仍在启动时被显示为已停止响应的问题

items.en: Fixed Code Mode keeping in memory every large text file that code read, and memory growing each time a background subagent was woken
items.zh: 修复了 Code Mode 将代码读取的每个大型文本文件都保留在内存中，以及每次唤醒后台 subagent 时内存增长的问题

items.en: Fixed Code Mode stopping a script at its ten-minute limit while an MCP form, an MCP link prompt or a prompt that always asks was waiting for an answer
items.zh: 修复了 Code Mode 在 MCP 表单、MCP 链接提示或始终询问的 prompt 等待回答时，脚本在十分钟限制处被停止的问题

items.en: Fixed Code Mode scripts receiving a "moved to the background" message as data from most MCP calls over two minutes: the script now waits up to ten minutes, then gets an error
items.zh: 修复了 Code Mode 脚本在大多数超过两分钟的 MCP 调用中把“moved to the background”消息当作数据接收的问题：脚本现在最多等待十分钟，然后收到错误

items.en: Fixed mods that list only some tools silently turning Code Mode off; such a mod no longer keeps it off, so use managed settings for that
items.zh: 修复了仅列出部分工具的 mod 会静默关闭 Code Mode 的问题；此类 mod 不再使其保持关闭，请改用托管设置实现

items.en: Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn when the tool was called from a script that Claude waits for
items.zh: 修复了当 MCP 工具从 Claude 等待的脚本中调用时，Code Mode 忽略该工具结束本轮请求的问题

items.en: Fixed a Code Mode script's `let x;` keeping the value that an earlier script gave `x`
items.zh: 修复了 Code Mode 脚本中的 `let x;` 保留先前脚本赋给 `x` 的值的问题

items.en: Fixed a Code Mode script's call with no argument failing with a missing-parameter error on tools that need none
items.zh: 修复了 Code Mode 脚本对不需要参数的工具进行无参数调用时因缺少参数而失败的问题

items.en: Fixed Code Mode scripts losing access to tools through `tools` in sessions with more than 4,096 tools
items.zh: 修复了在工具超过 4,096 个的 session 中，Code Mode 脚本通过 `tools` 失去工具访问权限的问题

items.en: Fixed the `/code-review` findings card often showing "high" for a review that ran at medium, on most models
items.zh: 修复了在大多数模型上，`/code-review` 发现卡片对以 medium 级别运行的审查经常显示“high”的问题

items.en: Fixed key hints in permission prompts, questions, `/model` and `/rewind` ignoring `keybindings.json`
items.zh: 修复权限提示、提问、`/model` 和 `/rewind` 中的按键提示忽略 `keybindings.json` 的问题

items.en: Fixed auto-scroll, the PR status badge, the auto-compact warning and the ultracode tag not following the `/config` switches that control them in a running session
items.zh: 修复在运行中的 session 里，自动滚动、PR 状态徽章、自动压缩警告和 ultracode 标签不跟随控制它们的 `/config` 开关的问题

items.en: Fixed a custom cancel key not working in `/add-dir`, `/tui` feedback and the save-workflow form
items.zh: 修复自定义取消键在 `/add-dir`、`/tui` 反馈和保存工作流表单中不生效的问题

items.en: Fixed arrow keys in the save-workflow form moving the selection in the workflow view behind it
items.zh: 修复保存工作流表单中的方向键会移动其后方工作流视图中的选中项的问题

items.en: Fixed `/config` saying nothing, or "dismissed", after changing many settings
items.zh: 修复 `/config` 在更改多项设置后不显示任何内容或显示“dismissed”的问题

items.en: Fixed Read and @-mentions showing one line too many for files that end in a newline
items.zh: 修复 Read 和 @ 提及对以换行结尾的文件多显示一行的问题

items.en: Fixed `/status` not naming the model that opusplan and haiku use in plan mode
items.zh: 修复 `/status` 未标明 opusplan 和 haiku 在 plan 模式下使用的模型的问题

items.en: Fixed `claude doctor` advising a Keychain unlock inside a macOS sandbox, where unlocking can't help
items.zh: 修复 `claude doctor` 在 macOS 沙盒内建议解锁 Keychain 的问题，该环境下解锁无法解决问题

items.en: Fixed the "Jump to bottom" pill staying hidden after copying text and scrolling away, the row under it going blank when its label changed, and quick PageUp presses scrolling too far in fullscreen
items.zh: 修复复制文本并滚动离开后“Jump to bottom”胶囊仍保持隐藏、其标签变化时下方行变为空白，以及全屏下快速按 PageUp 滚动过远的问题

items.en: Fixed a screen update sometimes being skipped when memory is low
items.zh: 修复内存不足时有时跳过屏幕更新的问题

items.en: Fixed long code blocks losing a blank line and repeating another in scrollback
items.zh: 修复长代码块在回滚缓冲区中丢失一个空行并重复另一个空行的问题

items.en: Fixed prompt suggestions sometimes showing placeholder text such as `_(no suggestion)_`
items.zh: 修复 prompt 建议有时显示 `_(no suggestion)_` 等占位文本的问题

items.en: Fixed the line about earlier messages on resume blaming a damaged file when the file was intact
items.zh: 修复恢复时关于更早消息的提示在文件完好时误称文件已损坏的问题

items.en: Fixed characters disappearing from the prompt when its text held a color code that sets several styles and a keyword or command was highlighted
items.zh: 修复当 prompt 文本包含设置多种样式的颜色代码且有关键词或命令被高亮时，字符从 prompt 中消失的问题

items.en: Fixed `/rename` and `UserPromptSubmit` hook titles in `claude remote-control` sessions not showing on claude.ai and mobile
items.zh: 修复 `claude remote-control` session 中 `/rename` 和 `UserPromptSubmit` hook 标题不在 claude.ai 和移动端显示的问题

items.en: Fixed the Remote Control diff listing a file twice when the branch renamed it and it was then edited
items.zh: 修复当分支重命名文件后又编辑该文件时，Remote Control 差异将文件列出两次的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed being signed out of Claude Code in every window and terminal when the sign-in server took 10 to 30 seconds to answer the extension's token refresh
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复当登录服务器需要 10 到 30 秒才响应扩展的 token 刷新时，所有窗口和终端中的 Claude Code 被登出的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed keys pressed while an input method (IME) is composing moving focus on or declining a permission prompt, running menu rows and closing dialogs (anthropics/claude-code#106358)
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复在输入法（IME）组词期间按下的按键会移动焦点、拒绝权限提示、执行菜单行或关闭对话框的问题（anthropics/claude-code#106358）

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the permission prompt for Bash, Edit, Write and other built-in tools not showing why a safety check asks
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复 Bash、Edit、Write 等内置工具的权限提示不显示安全检查询问原因的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a half-written plan comment being lost or moved to another passage, and an input method's Enter sending the comment, ending a session rename or picking an @-mentioned file
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复写到一半的 plan 评论丢失或被移到另一段落，以及输入法的 Enter 键会发送评论、结束 session 重命名或选中 @ 提及的文件的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the limit banner not saying when usage credits are in use, and the session survey covering that banner and the usage credits card
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了使用用量额度时限制横幅未说明这一点，以及 session 调查问卷遮挡该横幅和用量额度卡片的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed screen readers not announcing a permission request that arrived while the Account & Usage dialog was open until that dialog was closed
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了 Account & Usage 对话框打开期间收到权限请求时，屏幕阅读器不播报、直到该对话框关闭才播报的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a proposed-edit diff tab staying open, with an Accept button that did nothing, after its terminal Claude Code session disconnected
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了终端中的 Claude Code session 断开后，提议编辑的 diff 标签页仍保持打开且 Accept 按钮无响应的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed short tool inputs and outputs cut off at the panel's edge with no way to read the rest (they now open in an editor tab), and dragging to select text also opening one
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了较短的 tool 输入和输出在面板边缘被截断且无法查看其余内容的问题（现改为在编辑器标签页中打开），以及拖动选择文本时也会打开标签页的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed the Up key putting an earlier message over text that an input method (IME) is composing in the message box (anthropics/claude-code#101294)
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了按上方向键时，较早的消息覆盖输入法（IME）正在消息框中组合的文本的问题（anthropics/claude-code#101294）

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed dropping an Explorer folder onto the chat inserting nothing on VS Code 1.103 to 1.139 or in a floating chat window, and the drop highlight vanishing with a false "Hold Shift" hint
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了在 VS Code 1.103 至 1.139 或浮动聊天窗口中，将资源管理器文件夹拖放到聊天中不插入任何内容，以及拖放高亮消失并错误显示“Hold Shift”提示的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed a permission prompt moving keyboard focus away from the details you were scrolling as its buttons switched on
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了权限提示的按钮启用时，键盘焦点从正在滚动查看的详情上移走的问题

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening in another editor group when `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` is off (anthropics/claude-code#108884)
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了当 `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` 关闭时，Claude 标签页中的文件链接在另一个编辑器组中打开的问题（anthropics/claude-code#108884）

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed ranges written with a single tilde (`3~5 … 7~10`) losing their tildes and showing struck-through text between them; only `~~text~~` is struck through now
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了用单个波浪号书写的范围（`3~5 … 7~10`）丢失波浪号并在其间显示删除线文本的问题；现在只有 `~~text~~` 会显示删除线

items.en: \[VSCode] Fixed dictation errors wrapping into a narrow column, the spinner turning while a question card waits, and a NUL symbol after each letter in the output of a failed UTF-16 command
items.zh: \[VSCode] 修复了听写错误被折行到狭窄列中、问题卡片等待时加载指示器仍在旋转，以及失败的 UTF-16 命令输出中每个字母后出现 NUL 符号的问题

summary.tldr: 新增 /tasks 定时任务与信任警告，改进 Code Mode 与内存，修复大量问题。

highlights.title: 定时任务需重新调度
highlights.detail: 早期版本保存的定时任务在新登录 session 中大多需重新调度；用 --resume 恢复原 session 时仍会运行。
highlights.action: 在新 session 中重新创建需要的定时任务，或使用 --resume 恢复原 session。

highlights.title: Code Mode hook 失败不再拦截
highlights.detail: Code Mode 中出错的 PreToolUse hook 不再拒绝脚本的工具调用；需要强制拒绝的命令、HTTP 或 MCP 工具 hook 须显式配置。
highlights.action: 对必须拒绝的 hook 设置 "onFailure": "block"。

highlights.title: 移除 max_tokens 自动重试
highlights.detail: 不再按 max_tokens 错误指定的上限自动重试；位于输出 token 更少的网关之后时需手动设置上限。
highlights.action: 将 CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS 设为网关允许的上限。

highlights.title: /tasks 汇总后台任务
highlights.detail: /tasks 现列出本次 session 的定时任务、/loop 唤醒、目标与对话分叉，并可询问后停止其中一个；后台数量统一为一个数字。

highlights.title: 内存与性能改进
highlights.detail: 降低大量文件编辑、大型 MCP 结果、长时间 Desktop/SDK session 及 --resume 后的内存占用，并缩短 Code Mode 大量工具调用后的终端卡顿。

highlights.title: 修复配置与登录问题
highlights.detail: 修复 ~/.claude.json 在读取失败时被重置为默认值、macOS 钥匙串无法写入导致反复登出，以及 /terminal-setup 损坏 VS Code 设置等问题。
